topic: Google Gemini 4 Argon (consumer + API launch, chat-to-tasks toggle, connected apps)

claims.claim: Google calls Gemini 4 Argon "our new frontier model", positioned as "our frontier model for real-world coding, enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense." Announced Sep 30, 2026 by Koray Kavukcuoglu (SVP, Google DeepMind; Chief AI Architect). Name meaning ('Argon') is not explained in any Google source checked.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence

claims.claim: Model card: Argon is the next generation of Gemini natively multimodal reasoning models, "is not a modification or a fine-tune of a prior model"; sparse mixture-of-experts transformer; text/image/audio/video in, text out; up to 1M-token combined context; knowledge cutoff March 2026. Distributed via Gemini app, Gemini API, Google AI Studio, Gemini for business, Google Antigravity and Google AI Mode.

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon - Model Card

claims.claim: Phased release: on Sep 30 Argon was rolling out first to "a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program" (released to them "without cyber guardrails"), with broader release to start "with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers."

sources.title: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence

claims.claim: General availability Oct 13, 2026: "Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available today for developers and enterprises via the API in AI Studio and Gemini platform"; Ultra subscribers get it in Google Antigravity; Ultra and Pro subscribers can try it "in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search."

claims.claim: Steps (web/Mac): go to gemini.google.com or open the Gemini Mac app -> click "Task" below the text box -> describe what you want (optionally say when it should run, type @ to pick a skill, ask for generated files, pick a model/thinking level from the model menu; add files via Upload & tools) -> click Submit and monitor; Gemini may ask you to take over its browser for some steps.

sources.title: Manage your tasks & workflows in Gemini Apps

claims.claim: Tasks requirements: 18+, personal Google Account (work/school not supported for now), Google AI Pro or Ultra, Keep Activity on, opted in to Personal Intelligence. Surfaces: Gemini mobile app, Gemini Mac app, gemini.google.com. Not available in the EEA, Nigeria, Switzerland or the UK.

sources.title: Manage your tasks & workflows in Gemini Apps

claims.claim: Help Center example tasks: declutter your inbox (summarise/archive newsletters, unsubscribe); custom news digest; monitor flight and hotel prices and alert when in budget; research a topic with cited sources and package results into PDFs, docs, spreadsheets or presentations. "Tasks can be scheduled to run at a specific date and time or in response to an event."

claims.claim: Tasks limits: "You can have up to 15 tasks running at a given time"; usage limits are compute-based and higher on higher plans. Turn off via Settings > Task settings > 'Use task mode to hand off work' > Turn off (schedules pause, nothing deleted).

claims.claim: API model ID: gemini-4-argon (stable). Context 1,048,576 tokens unified input+output; max output 65,536 by default, up to 1,048,576 with long decode. Input text/image/video/audio/PDF; output text only. No image/audio generation, no Live API, explicit caching unsupported (implicit only); computer use in Preview; thinking levels low/medium/high.
